{{Quote|You feeling brave? Here--plasma grenade! We're pinned down, but this ought to burn those rats good! Pop it in their hole and flush them out!|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Namarr]]|<ref name="Trapped" />}}
The '''M1SR-F plasma grenade''' was a type of [[Plasma grenade/Legends|plasma grenade]].<ref name="Trapped" /> In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Date">[[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-controlled [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' is set during Act II. Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act II takes place in [[3642 BBY]].</ref> during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the latter's [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] made use of the [[Grenade/Legends|grenade]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] against the [[Valhoun's Vultures]], a group of elite Republic [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]]. The grenade was used to flush out enemy combatants from hardpoints and foxholes on the battlefield.<ref name="Trapped" />
